post.description: Create, replace or add rows to a Tosca Cloud test data set from a DataMaker set, input set version, dataset or inline rows. Test steps read it as {TDM[<data set>][<subset>][<column>]}. The rows are read server-side with the caller's access (set:read, inputSetEntry:read or dataset:read) and uploaded as one JSON file, so text such as '0012' stays text; an append adds them row by row. An input set gets one subset per test case by default. Tosca's test data API is not a published Tricentis API. Every push is recorded in the audit trail.

name.description: The Tosca data set to create or replace. Test steps read it as {TDM[<name>][<column>]}.

onExisting.description: When a data set of that name exists: "fail" refuses, "overwrite" replaces its rows (keeping its id and subsets), "new" lets Tosca create a copy beside it. "append" adds the rows to it and leaves every existing row as it is, used or not, so a scenario can feed fresh rows to tests that consume them; it creates the data set when there is none, takes at most 1000 rows, and adds the rows again if pushed again. "sync" is for an input set only: it creates the data set, or brings it in line row by row. An unchanged row is left alone, a changed row replaces its unused Tosca row or, once a test has used it, is appended as a new row, and a row removed from the sheet is deleted from Tosca unless a test used it. Rows carry a DataMakerRow key column.

onSchemaChange.description: On overwrite, when the rows drop a column the data set has: "refuse" answers 409, "recreate" deletes and recreates the data set (test steps keep working; its id and subsets are lost). Added columns are always handled.
